users: researchers processing declared modified ASTM D5470 thermal-resistance tests
not_intended_for: an ASTM-compliance certificate, a calibrated material-property result without instrument and specimen evidence, or a general claim of uncertainty validity beyond the declared test configuration

required_inputs: declared material, TIM state, and test-run files

limitations: Repository documentation does not establish calibration, ASTM conformance, specimen traceability, or model-form validity for a new test campaign.
York regression accounts for declared x and y uncertainties but does not validate their estimates.
